What we move

A full freight desk, without the overhead.

From a single pallet to a full container, the same capabilities cover the journey from origin factory to your UK door.

Sea freight

FCL and LCL consolidation, port to port or door to door, on established China–UK and Gulf lanes.

Air freight

Express and economy airfreight for time-critical orders, with consolidation to keep costs honest.

Customs clearance

Import and export clearance through our UK broker, with Postponed VAT Accounting handled for you.

Warehousing & prep

Storage, re-pack, labelling and Amazon FBA prep close to the major UK gateways.

UK distribution

Pallet network, next-day and full-load delivery to anywhere in mainland Britain.

Inspection & QC

Factory inspection and quality control at origin, so issues are caught before goods ever ship.

How it works

Your single point of contact — backed by a network.

We do not run the ships and trucks ourselves. We hold the relationship, the contract and the responsibility, and direct an execution network that is already operational at origin.

STEP 01

You contract with Caspian Bridge

One UK company, answerable under English law. You quote, book and pay us — never an unfamiliar overseas forwarder.

STEP 02

We coordinate execution

Our partners in China and Dubai handle origin collection, consolidation, export and transit. You stay out of the operational detail.

STEP 03

Cleared, delivered, one invoice

Customs handled in the UK, goods delivered to your door, and a single settlement from Caspian Bridge.

CUSTOMER  →  CASPIAN BRIDGE  →  EXECUTION NETWORK
